allOf.description: The number of records that might have failed processing. This number might be greater than 0 even if the PutRecordBatch call succeeds. Check FailedPutCount to determine whether there are records that you need to resend.
Indicates whether server-side encryption (SSE) was enabled during this operation.
The results array. For each record, the index of the response element is the same as the index used in the request array.
